requirements.title: The existing external units for an image are processor dependent
requirements.definition: At any given time, the set of external units that exist for an image is processor dependent.

pending.external-unit-existence-set-processor-de: No portable oracle may assume that a particular ordinary unit number exists. Future tests establish existence with OPEN(NEWUNIT=...) or use named preconnected constants.

requirements.oracle: Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans establish a non-default state first (for example by writing known records, initializing variables to nonzero/nonblank sentinels, or creating a known file) and then observe only portable properties: exact internal records, successful IOSTAT zero, nonzero IOSTAT for a specified error condition, or named intrinsic status values where the standard names them. Processor-dependent unit numbers, file names, record lengths, storage-unit encodings, buffering, timing, IOMSG text, and specific error numbers are not asserted.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Source accounting only. This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Negative plans are source-control plans unless this unit itself requires rejection and a future fixture can observe the rejection portably. IOMSG wording and processor-dependent numeric status values are never an oracle.
requirements.dependencies: Registered dependencies: clauses 6, 8, 9, 10, and 11 for source form, names, expressions, execution constructs, and existing declaration/execution foundations. Unregistered dependencies explicitly retained: later clause 12 connection, specifier, file-position, data-transfer, internal-file, and input/output-item rules; clause 13 formatting; clause 15 defined I/O; clause 16 inquiry intrinsics where future fixtures need them; clauses 3, 5, 14, 17, 18, and 19 where terminology, constants, images, IEEE support, deleted features, or scope/lifetime controls are reached.

requirements.title: Input/output statements are permitted to refer to units that exist
requirements.definition: All input/output statements are permitted to refer to units that exist.

pending.io-statements-may-refer-existing-units: Establish an existing unit with OPEN(NEWUNIT=...) or a named preconnected unit, then exercise each statement only after its statement-specific rules are registered; assert statement-owned effects with nondefault sentinels.

requirements.title: CLOSE, INQUIRE, and WAIT may refer to units that do not exist
requirements.definition: The CLOSE, INQUIRE, and WAIT statements are permitted to refer to units that do not exist.

requirements.title: Other input/output statements shall not refer to units that do not exist
requirements.definition: No input/output statement other than CLOSE, INQUIRE, or WAIT shall refer to a unit that does not exist.

pending.nonexistent-units-prohibited-for-other-i: Negative source controls must first establish nonexistence portably, which is generally unavailable for ordinary numbers. Diagnostic observation is deferred; do not rely on a guessed invalid unit, IOMSG text, or a specific IOSTAT value.

accounting.rationale: Processor latitude over the external-unit existence set.
Mixed permissions and a shall-not restriction are split.
Permission for all I/O statements to refer to existing units.
Special permission for CLOSE, INQUIRE, and WAIT.
Restriction on other statements referencing nonexistent units.

review_rationale: Source registration for 12.5-12.5.5, units and their connection to files (batch150). Every unit hash-verified against the pinned census by an independent reviewer across two rounds. Round 1 found an over-suppressed facet - that an unformatted connection has no changeable modes IS portably observable through INQUIRE returning UNDEFINED for BLANK=, DECIMAL=, DELIM=, LEADING_ZERO=, PAD=, ROUND= and SIGN= - and a conditional C1202 negative, now recorded as source-only because no character kind beyond default, ASCII and ISO 10646 is guaranteed. The five numbered rules R1201-R1203, C1201 and C1202 were pre-accounted. Source accounting only.
